admission.justification: A future memory route must not silently introduce an attribution producer or disguise backfill as content creation; named census rejection tests and the original-tree rewriter assertion directly guard this durable boundary.

applicability: The production memory-content attribution producer census and its single renderer.
conditions: Ordinary content producers are worktree closeout, direct landing and baseline adoption; the model renderer and kernel/memory_backfill.py are separately enumerated exact paths.
The history rewriter constructs its replacement from the original commit tree, not worktree or index contents.
Statically recognized direct, imported-alias, assignment-alias and literal-getattr calls are checked against the exact path set.
exclusions: Carryover only prepares the recovery memory worktree and is not a content-commit producer.
No directory/pattern exemption and no additional content producer.
The AST census is not a promise to detect arbitrary dynamically constructed reflection or external code.
statement: Memory creation uses worktree closeout, direct landing and baseline adoption through the one attribution renderer; the historical rewriter is separately pinned.
